$comment: MCP tool contract for workspace-mcp, exposing read-only workspace introspection. The consumer is a planning chat. Every tool is a pure read.

tools.name: list_repos
tools.description: List all service repositories in the workspace with their roles.

tools.name: get_system_map
tools.description: Get the contents of the system architecture map (docs/ai/SYSTEM.md).

tools.name: list_contracts
tools.description: List all machine-readable contract filenames in the contracts/ directory.

tools.name: get_contract
tools.description: Get the contents of a specific contract file from the contracts/ directory.

tools.name: dependency_graph
tools.description: Get the dependency graph output (consumer -> provider edges).

tools.name: read_repo_file
tools.description: Read the contents of a specific file inside a repository, sandboxed to that repo.
